newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening slightly higher Tuesday, in line with LME copper, with the market seen continuing to recover from last week's downward correction to the latest leg of a rally.
COMEX July copper was seen opening unchanged to up 0.30 cent, from Monday's close at 117.55 cents, after trading between 117.50 and 118.20 in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME warehouse stocks fell a further 2,750 tonnes in Tuesday's data to 128,125 tonnes, while COMEX copper stocks rose 1,393 short tons to 43,421 short tons Monday.
